verdict.rationale: Pinecone's API reference shows static per-language example requests. A docs probe found the Mintlify playground set to 'simple', with the interactive in-page runner disabled and no 'Try it' control on endpoint pages. The OpenAPI specs and Prism-based local mock are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not an interactive reference with runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page API explorer, runnable 'Try it' examples against the live API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: per-language example requests with the interactive in-page runner disabled; no "Try it" control renders on the endpoint pages
